title: Is there a way to view the visualizer without submitting?
source: kaggle CLI: competitions topic-messages (authorName field was empty in CLI output for all messages)

messages.author: (unknown - CLI returned empty authorName)
messages.content: Would be helpful for reading some of our own local runs quick and diagnosing obvious issues without taking up 1/5 daily runs for each issue. We can view the JSON logs but visualizer locally would be nice.

messages.author: (unknown)
messages.content: It would be great if we can see actual cards in the visualizer.

messages.content:
[screenshot image] https://github.com/hiro094/PTCG_ABCS_Visualizer

messages.author: (unknown - sponsor team member; linked notebook by kiyotah)
messages.content: Hi there, The sponsor team has created this official notebook you can use: https://www.kaggle.com/code/kiyotah/how-to-output-local-battle-as-json-and-view

messages.author: (unknown)
messages.content:
You can save this (AI generated) javascript as bookmark of your browser. And click it at the official ptcg visualizer website, and upload your vis.json
javascript:(function(){const i=document.createElement('input');i.type='file';i.accept='.json';i.onchange=function(e){const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=function(ev){const o=JSON.parse(ev.target.result);const h=document.createElement('input');h.type='hidden';h.name='json';h.value='steps'in o?JSON.stringify(o.steps[0][0].visualize):ev.target.result;const fm=document.createElement('form');fm.method='POST';fm.action='https://ptcgvis.heroz.jp/Visualizer/Replay/0';fm.target='_blank';fm.appendChild(h);document.body.appendChild(fm);fm.submit();document.body.removeChild(fm);};r.readAsText(f);};i.click();})();

messages.content: this was refrectored from the official notebook which requires a local html to jump to the website and upload the json file
